title: MIDI Controls
text: Output values from controls on MIDI control surface, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {MIDI control numbers} sets Control numbers associated with MIDI surface controllers that your block responds to; {MIDI device} sets the mIDI control surface your block listens, {MIDI device name} sets the device name of MIDI control surface your block listens to character, {MIDI controls} sets the if block responds to all controllers or specific controllers on MIDI surface Respond to any, {Initial values} controls numbers associated with MIDI surface controllers that your block responds, {Send initial values to device at start} sets the synchronize MIDI surface with values specified initial and {Output Mode} sets the output mode for MIDI control value. Values come from the instance.

params.name: MIDI device
params.values: MIDI control surface your block listens to Default (default) | Specify other

params.name: MIDI device name
params.values: Device name of MIDI control surface your block listens to character vector

params.name: MIDI controls
params.values: Specify if block responds to all controllers or specific controllers on MIDI surface Respond to any control (default) | Respond to specified controls

params.name: MIDI control numbers
params.values: Control numbers associated with MIDI surface controllers that your block responds to 0 (default) | integer | array of integers

params.name: Initial values
params.values: Control numbers associated with MIDI surface controllers that your block responds to 0 (default) | scalar | array

params.name: Send initial values to device at start
params.values: Synchronize MIDI surface with values specified initial values off (default) | on

params.name: Output Mode
params.values: Output mode for MIDI control value Normalized (0-1) (default) | RAW MIDI (0-127)
